text:
Emma L.: Quick sync: we saw a regression in quant performance on CUDA12.2 in staging. Proposing GA pin to CUDA12.1 + driver 535, with ROCm 6.3 as fallback for AMD hosts. Need partner confirmation before marketplace release next Tue. @Tim - HWPartner any ETA on the hotfix?

Tim - HWPartner: Confirmed. Driver 540 introduces a cuBLAS micro-ABI tweak that impacts quant kernels. HW team has a hotfix candidate; ETA ~48h. If you need to ship earlier, pin to 12.1/535.

Raj P.: Staging canary logs: https://staging-logs/repro/2376548820 — A100 perf drop noticeable with 12.2+540 config. Canary started: redwood-canary-7.

Micah (eng-runtime): Agree to pin 12.1 for GA. Plan: eu-west canary 24h, then progressive rollout. We'll add kernel mismatch fallback to ROCm path and implement KV-cache warmup guard.

Natalie (Partnerships): I'll delay the public announcement until pins confirmed. Draft message will mention temporary pin and forthcoming driver patch.

deploy-bot: Canary redwood-canary-7 launched. Watch: /canary/redwood-canary-7

metrics-bot: 3h snapshot: p95 +7.5%, error rate 0.35%. Link: https://metrics/reports/2376548820

Raj P.: Creating INFRA-2398 to add regtest: `./tools/regtest --gpu a100 --cuda 12.1 --driver 535`. Also will add a CI gate for marketplace AMIs.

Micah (eng-runtime): I'll reduce max_batch for canary to avoid KV fallback thrash and run perf. Will post numbers.

Tim - HWPartner: Uploaded hotfix candidate: s3://partner-drivers/540-hotfix-2026-03-20.tar.gz sha256: abc123def456. Will provide signed artifact in ~6h.

Emma L.: Actions: Micah run perf with reduced batch, Raj add regtest gate, Tim share signed hotfix if QA passes, Natalie hold announcement. Sync in 11:00 AM PST tomorrow.

Micah (eng-runtime): Perf with batch cap -50%: p95 +2% in canary, token cost +0.5%. Details later.

Emma L.: Thanks team. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
